# acecloud_router_interface (Resource)

Manages an Ace Cloud router interface (attaches a subnet to a router).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "acecloud_router_interface" "main" {
  router_id = acecloud_router.main.id
  subnet_id = acecloud_vpc.main.subnet_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `router_id` (String) ID of the router to attach the subnet to.
- `subnet_id` (String) ID of the subnet to attach to the router.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Port ID of the router interface.
- `ip_address` (String) IP address of the router interface on the subnet.
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the router interface.
- `status` (String) Current status of the router interface.
